path.description: Paste the absolute path (e.g. <path>/Users/you/project</path>) into the input field.

mac.step1: Open Finder and navigate to the folder.
mac.step3: Hold the Option (⌥) key — "Copy" changes to "Copy as Pathname".
mac.step4: Click "Copy as Pathname", then paste here.
mac.tip: You can also open Terminal, type cd, drag the folder into the terminal window, and press Enter. Then type pwd to see the full path.

windows.step1: Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder.
windows.step2: Click in the address bar at the top — the full path will appear.
windows.step3: Copy the path, then paste here.
windows.tip: Alternatively, hold Shift and right-click the folder, then select "Copy as path".

linux.step1: Open a terminal and navigate to the directory with cd.
linux.step2: Run pwd to print the full path.
linux.step3: Copy the output and paste here.
linux.tip: In most file managers, Ctrl+L reveals the full path in the address bar.

muse.description: Muse uses its own tools and permissions. Paperclip coordinates company tasks and questions. Provider usage and cost are unavailable.
muse.disabled: Muse is disabled in experimental settings. Connection cleanup and stop evidence remain available.
muse.publicOrigin: An authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL is required to connect Muse.
muse.disconnected: Disconnected. Paperclip credentials and execution authority were revoked.
muse.removalRequested: Detector removal requested; completion is not confirmed.
muse.afterDisconnect: After disconnect, the receiver disables itself when it next reaches Paperclip. Cleanup cannot be confirmed through the revoked connection.
muse.separateCleanup: Detector removal, worker stopping, and sandbox cleanup are separate. Paperclip cannot verify every private Muse tool or stop all personal Muse conversations.
muse.unknownEffects: Native effect outcomes remain unknown and block replacement work. Worker attestation does not resolve or replay those effects.
muse.missingStopRevision: Stop binding revision is unavailable. Refresh to inspect this assignment before attesting.
muse.recordExact: Record an observation of this exact detector
muse.digestHelp: Use the digest of the secret-free runtime observation. Do not paste the listing, a URL, credentials, or private tool output.
muse.observedAtHelp: Enter the actual runtime listing time, not the time you submit this form. Paperclip checks it against revocation and the qualification deadline.
muse.detectorConsent: I observed this exact hook absent in the supported runtime listing after revocation. This attests detector removal only, not worker stopping or private effects.
muse.confirmExactWorker: Confirm the worker for this exact assignment stopped
muse.workerConsent: I have stopped this Muse worker for the named assignment and run. This does not certify independent private tools or unknown native effects.
muse.saveFirst: Save the agent, then connect your personal Muse here.
muse.identityFailed: Unable to confirm your account. Refresh to inspect this Muse connection.
muse.operatorStopped: You attested that this assignment’s Muse worker stopped.
muse.workerQuiescent: Muse reported that this assignment’s worker is quiescent. Independent private effects remain unconfirmed.
muse.stopUnknown: Paperclip fenced this assignment’s authority. Its external stop cannot be confirmed.
muse.loadFailed: Unable to load the Muse connection.
muse.contactLag_one: Receiver contact is persisted in batches and may lag by up to {{count}} second. Public receiver checks are unverified. Only an authenticated reply confirms Muse can work.
muse.contactLag_other: Receiver contact is persisted in batches and may lag by up to {{count}} seconds. Public receiver checks are unverified. Only an authenticated reply confirms Muse can work.
muse.evidenceOperator: Recorded {{time}}: operator attestation from a supported runtime hook listing. This is not independent provider confirmation.
muse.evidenceWorker: Recorded {{time}}: authenticated worker report. This is not independent provider confirmation.
muse.detectorHelp: Use Muse’s supported <command>{{command}}</command> after revocation to verify this exact registered script is absent. Disabled checks, silence, or a removal request are insufficient. The retained hook ID and observation are your report. Paperclip does not verify installation, query Muse, or remove the hook.
